title: Upload chunks in parallel, with retries
body:
Large uploads were slow because parts went up one at a time, and a single failed part failed the whole upload.

- Up to 4 parts are in flight at once; the storage service assembles them by part number, so order does not matter.
- Each part is retried up to 3 times with a linear backoff.
- Progress events and the final completeness check are unchanged.
